summary: Centurion Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a postponement of its extraordinary general meeting from June 9 to June 12, 2026, to approve an amendment extending the deadline for an initial business combination by one year to June 12, 2027. The filing also extends the shareholder redemption deadline to June 10. This is a routine procedural step for a SPAC seeking more time to complete a business combination; no definitive deal, target, or material special situation event is disclosed.
